'''Poison arrows''' are [[:Category:Arrows|ammunition]] for bows. Most arrows' damage comes primarily from their pierce damage, with potential secondary damage, like [[Silver Arrow]]s. However, poison arrows' damage primarily comes from their damage over time [[Damage#Poison|poison]] effect, with pierce damage being the lesser.


== Availability ==
* [[Ooze]] is found within the [[Swamp]] [[Biomes|biome]] by killing [[Blob]]s and [[Oozer]]s.
* [[Obsidian]] can be found within the [[Mountain]] [[Biomes|biome]].
* Poison arrows can occasionally be found in chests inside [[Sunken Crypts]] in the [[Swamp]] [[Biomes|biome]].


== Features ==
* Deals damage divided between poison and pierce damage.
* The poison effect stacks with that of the [[Draugr Fang]].

'''Ooze bomb''' is a thrown weapon that creates a [[Poison]] 4-meter radius AoE cloud, which stays for 10 seconds. Anyone in the cloud (excluding the thrower) takes 40 poison damage over 7 seconds. If an enemy stays in the cloud, the damage is refreshed, so the maximum damage is 40*(10+7)/7 = 97.

Damage value does not depend on any player skill, but may be altered by enemy resistance.

== Availability ==
* Crafted with the [[Workbench]], stacks up to 50
* [[Ooze]] can be found in the [[Swamp]] biome by killing [[Blob]]s and [[Oozer]]s
* [[Leather Scraps]] are found in [[Chest]]s in the [[Meadows]] biome, dropped from [[Boar]]s or [[Bat]]s or mined from [[Muddy Scrap Pile]]s.
* [[Resin]] is dropped by [[Greydwarf]], [[Greydwarf Shaman]] and [[Greydwarf Brute]]. It has a chance of dropping from chopped [[Birch]] and [[Pine]] trees, and [[Beech|Smaller Beech Trees]].
